signal: README.md documents multi-provider routing with automatic tier escalation on failure
impact: Agent task stalls or returns errors; incomplete output persisted as signal
trigger: LLM provider returns 5xx errors or network connection drops mid-call
mitigation: Configure fallback_model in roko.toml; enable tier-based escalation to next viable provider

signal: crates/roko-core/src/config/timeouts.rs defines task_attempt_secs default 600 and llm_call_secs default 120
impact: Task killed mid-execution; partial work may corrupt workspace state or signal DAG
trigger: Agent dispatch or single LLM call exceeds configured timeout threshold
mitigation: Tune [timeouts] in roko.toml; use --resume-plan to recover from checkpointed state

signal: README.md documents 7-rung gate pipeline that short-circuits on first failure
impact: Verification gate rejects agent output; plan stalls if task cannot pass compile or test gates
trigger: cargo check or cargo test or clippy returns non-zero exit code during gate run
mitigation: Retries with escalating models; adaptive thresholds relax on repeated failures

signal: Cargo.toml lists orchestrator crate with worktree manager for parallel task execution
impact: Merge conflicts; corrupted build artifacts; cross-contamination of branch state
trigger: Multiple agents operate on overlapping file paths within shared worktrees
mitigation: Worktree manager creates isolated git worktrees per task; workspace_lock_secs guards access

signal: README.md documents roko plan run plans/ --resume-plan for interrupted plan recovery
impact: In-progress plan execution lost; tasks must be re-dispatched from scratch
trigger: Process crash or SIGTERM during plan execution before durable checkpoint
mitigation: Use --resume-plan flag; signals persisted as content-addressed BLAKE3 DAG records
